column3: Focus window left / down / up / right
Swap window in that direction
Shrink / grow focused window
Balance sizes
Fullscreen focused window
Toggle float / tile (for apps that fight tiling)
Flip tile orientation (horizontal ↔ vertical)
Reload Aerospace config
Split horizontally
Split vertically
Focus pane left/down/up/right (vim-aware — also jumps into nvim splits)
New tmux window
Jump to tmux window N
Last tmux window
Detach session (keep running, return with tmux attach)
Enter copy mode — scroll + select with vi keys (v select, y yank)
Reload tmux config
Previous / next tmux window
Session picker — every running session plus zoxide history; attaches, or creates if it is not running yet
Clear screen (bare <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd> belongs to vim-tmux-navigator)
Scratch popup — a persistent shell, same one every time, from any session
lazygit in a popup, in the current pane's repo
Throwaway shell popup (fresh each time — contrast <kbd class="mod">Opt</kbd>+<kbd>G</kbd>)
URL picker for the pane — newest first; Tab multi-selects, Ctrl+Y copies instead of opening
In copy mode: open the selection (URL, file, or directory)
Open a link directly. Shift is required because tmux owns the mouse
Break this pane out into its own window (stays put — the new window is created detached)
Join another pane into this window — pick the source from a tree
Move the current window left / right in the status bar (bare Shift+arrow moves between windows)
Edit ~/.tmux.conf in a popup; reloads on close
Hint mode — paints a letter on every SHA, path, IP and hex string on screen; type it to copy. Complements Ctrl+A U, which only ever matches URLs
In copy mode: open the selection in $EDITOR instead of the browser
